purpose: Purchased fishing kunai artwork matching the existing painted inventory icons

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final transparent square inventory/shop item artwork for an existing ninja fantasy RPG.
Primary request: paint the Basic Fishing Kunai as polished, detailed game item artwork matching the provided existing item icons.
Input images: Image 1 (rustfang kunai icon) is the PRIMARY STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference: painterly shaded metal, textured handle wrapping, strong clean silhouette, readable tiny item icon. Image 2 (ranked-format kunai icon) is a supporting style reference. Image 3 (horizontal steel kunai) is the WEAPON DESIGN reference: broad faceted steel triangular spearhead, black cloth wrapped grip, circular steel ring pommel. Do not copy any colored magic from the style references.
Subject: ONE practical tethered steel fishing kunai with its small wearable wrist-reel and a short coil of strong tan braided cord attached to the ring pommel. The reel is a compact round bronze-and-dark-metal line spool on a folded dark leather wrist cuff, visually a tool accessory, not a modern fishing rod reel. The cord links the kunai and reel plausibly and makes one loose elegant loop.
Composition: square image, kunai angled from sharp point at lower left toward ring pommel at upper right, occupying about 85% of the diagonal; compact wrist reel beside the lower right area, smaller than the blade. Whole object and tether visible, clean outer silhouette, about 6% transparent margin. Balanced object group, no cropping.
Style: hand-painted high-quality fantasy RPG inventory illustration like the provided icons; realistic material texture and dimensional painterly shading, crisp bevel highlights, subtle wear on forged steel, black cloth grip and aged leather, warm bronze fittings. Restrained common-tier design, no fantasy glow.
Lighting: soft warm upper-left light, cool steel reflections, deep readable contact shading within object, no backdrop shadow.
Background: true transparent alpha, no ground plane, no colored card, no vignette, no baked checkerboard. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no hands, no people, no fish, no fishing pole. Exactly one kunai and one connected compact wrist spool.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final transparent square Golden Fishing Kunai inventory/shop illustration for the same ninja fantasy RPG.
Edit target: the supplied Basic Fishing Kunai artwork. Create its premium permanent GOLD variant as a perfectly matched pair.
Preserve: the exact composition, blade silhouette and faceted shape, diagonal from lower-left sharp point to upper-right ring pommel, handle length, cord routing, single kunai, small wrist-reel position, leather cuff silhouette, transparent negative space, painterly style and sharp illustrated edges.
Change: repaint the blade, guard, pommel ring, fittings and reel housing to rich warm forged gold with bright pale-gold bevel highlights and deeper ochre shadow facets; add restrained finely engraved flowing water motifs on the blade flat and spool face without changing their geometry. Keep the wrapped grip dark charcoal and the leather cuff rich dark brown, with neat gold stitching. Braided tether remains natural tan-gold. The gold version should look carefully made and valuable rather than neon.
Style: detailed hand-painted fantasy RPG inventory cutout, visible material grain and subtle physical wear, same upper-left light and high-contrast shading as the target. Readable at 48 to 64 pixels.
Background: preserve true transparent alpha everywhere outside the object. No background, no card, no border, no ground, no large outer glow, no particle effects, no extra weapons, no fishing rod, no characters, no hands, no fish, no text, no logos, no watermark. Keep the entire item group inside frame with transparent margin.
